description: Get an asset's historical up-move frequency per timeframe (reference-class base rates) — the share of past windows in which it rose (1d/1w/1m/6m/1y), each with its sample size and `basis` ("individual" from the asset's own history, or "sector_fallback" when its sample was too small). Public, no API key needed. Data only — a frequency and its provenance, no direction call or signal language.
name: ldbd_get_base_rates
